additional_info.subject: ID0439268-DC/Si-D/GR-[Y2 / S4 313650404001]Charger issue CRM:02681000512
additional_info.body:
Hello Olympia, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
I tried searching from yesterday 17:00 UTC to 20:00 UTC (your 19:00 until 22:00) and I couldn't find any LED log or OCPP Preparing log. Also, the OCPP connection was stable throughout this time and there was no drop.
Is it possible that it's another charger? I really don't see any issue with this one.
Right now, the charger has all 3 outlets disabled on purpose, should I enable them?
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: FW: ID0439268-DC/Si-D/GR-[Y2 / S4 313650404001]Charger issue CRM:02681000512

Hello Francisco and thank you so much for supporting. I just got the information that this charger is disabled by them in order to procced with some actions requested by the owner.
They will enable the charger again.
We can close this ticket.
Olympia
